rules.statement: A person can intervene in proceedings under the Land Acquisition Ordinance and be heard, even if their claim is made after the land has been vested in the Crown.
rules.supporting_quote: Why, therefore, he should not be entitled to put forward his claim whilst the money is still in Court, and before it reaches the 1st defendant's hands, it is difficult to understand. The 7th defendant has been properly joined as a party, under the provisions of section 32 of the Ordinance, after notice to all the other parties, including the 1st defendant.

meta.parties: Government Agent, Sabaragamuwa v. Asirwathan Et Al
